title: Megababe Thigh Rescue Anti-Chafe Stick Mini | Travel size, great for on-the-go | Prevents skin chafe & irritation | Thighs, arms, bra-lines & more
features: ONE SOLD EVERY 30 SECONDS* – The go-to anti-chafe stick, trusted by customers worldwide for smooth, irritation-free skin. Use anywhere chafe is an issue! Ideal for bra straps that rub, waistbands that dig or shoes that blister (ie, anywhere skin is sensitive to rubbing!) *Based on 2024 Megababe sales data of Thigh Rescue & Thigh Rescue Mini

POCKET-SIZED CONVENIENCE - Keep the chafe away all day and throw this mini in your bag or pocket. The mini size makes it easy to re-apply as needed throughout the day. Keep a Thigh Rescue at home & in your bag!
THIGHS GLIDE, DON’T CHAFE – Swipe on Thigh Rescue to create a friction-free barrier that prevents chafe, blisters, irritation, and painful rash before it happens.

CLEAN, SKIN-LOVING FORMULA – Natural ingredients like aloe, pomegranate & grapeseed oil work to soothe, moisturize & protect chafe-prone skin. Free of aluminum, parabens, phthalates & sulfates. Featuring a fresh, barely-there citrusy scent
DERMATOLOGIST & GYNECOLOGIST APPROVED – Clinically tested and safe for sensitive skin, with an easy-glide, non-greasy formula that won’t feel sticky.
NO MESS APPLICATION - The portable balm stick is easy to apply and does not feel greasy or sticky on skin. The only thing you'll notice is the smooth, friction-free glide!
